frozen: 18 Oct 2026, under the author's instruction to freeze WP6 with the decisions of 18 Oct 2026 (docs/PMT_DECISIONS_LOG.md)
amendment_rule: changes only by a recorded, dated amendment before any held-out evaluation; never after inspecting held-out scores

detector.geometry: pinned LUCiD WCTE (upstream eaf2e89), 1995 PMTs in 105 mPMT modules
detector.transport: prompt direct light; uniform angular acceptance; no concentrators; scattering, reflection, absorption and dispersion off
detector.reference_response: configs/lucid_pmt/reference.json schema pmt-response-v2, built by response_manifest.reference_response with mPMT groups (D-G)

adopted.D-Q: charge domain [0.25, 1000] PE; overflow clamped and counted; below-domain charge rejected and counted
adopted.D-J: Gaussian timing kernel; digits before photon arrival reported per cell
adopted.D-K: a cell is unevaluable if the fit-failure rate exceeds 10% in its clean or shifted half; otherwise complete-case K with the failure-rate difference as a co-primary column (consequence.DK_MAX_FAILURE_RATE)
adopted.D-TQ: form a + b/sqrt(q) adopted; values a=0, b=2 ns, q_sat=50 PE remain synthetic_dev

modules.affected_set_per_cell: 5 modules drawn without replacement from the permitted (or held-out) set with numpy default_rng(perturbation_seed)

cells.change: reference parameters rebuilt; output must be bit-identical
response_manifest.exact_product_control (QE x 2, CE / 2); output must be bit-identical
CE x 0.8 with gain rescaled to match reference-fit total charge; not an exact degeneracy
QE_ref(lambda) * (1 + a h(lambda)), h anchors [0, -1, 0, 1, 0] on 200..800 nm, all channels
walk b -> b * s, reference walk frozen, all channels; charge and membership must be unchanged
timing_width_factor x w on the affected modules
gain x g and timing_width_factor x w jointly on the affected modules (one causal control, two declared fields)
gain x g on the affected modules
timing_width_factor x w on the affected modules
walk a -> a + 1 ns (offset only), all channels

held_out.severity: the larger grid point of every N family

K_vertex.endpoint: frozen vertex reconstruction against the primary starting position
K_vertex.paired: same physical events, shared keyed draws

K_energy.endpoint: D-E deposited energy (development default); initial energy only on contained events

K.aggregate: max(K_vertex, K_energy); unevaluable if either endpoint is undefined

kappa_m.note: author to confirm or replace at this freeze

splits.unit: physical event, all placements and twins together
splits.roles: configs/lucid_pmt/split_contract.json fractions (reference_fit 0.30, attribution_train 0.20, development 0.15, calibration 0.15, evaluation 0.20)
splits.event_counts: pending: set by the WP7 precision plan before generation

event_support.contained_initial_energy: mu- 100-350 MeV kinetic reach >= 50% containment (range-based, results/pmt_r4_dev_2026-10-18/containment); new contained tracks are a WP7 planning item
event_support.S_families: valid rare positions, directions and energies within the same detector and medium; confirmation with Junjie pending
